title: Video spec
description: Plan for a demo, launch or marketing film made with HyperFrames: canvas, story beats with start and duration in seconds, on-screen words, the source of every visual, and the claims that need evidence. scripts/video-check.mjs --spec validates it against this schema and then enforces the numeric rules (contiguous scenes, minimum runtime, hook first, call to action, reading load).

goal.description: What the viewer should do or understand at the end.

cta.description: The one action the closing beat asks for. Required for demo, launch, promo and teaser films.

direction.description: Design direction: preset name, token source or style skill. One style authority per film.

minDurationSeconds.description: Floor for the finished file. 60 for a one-minute-or-more film.

version.description: Pinned CLI version, for example the one written into the scaffold's package.json.

silent.description: True only when the user asked for no sound.

captions.description: Burned-in captions plus a sidecar file. Required when any scene has narration.

approvals.description: What the user approved, in their words or 'none'. Recorded so the report can quote it.

id.description: Also the host id, scene root id and timeline key in the composition.

start.description: Seconds from the start of the film.

shots.description: Number of distinct shots inside the beat. Defaults to 1.

text.description: Words shown on screen in this beat.

source.description: real: captured from the product or brand. drawn: original type or illustration. stock: licensed media. generated: AI-made media. none: type only.

sourceRef.description: File, URL or manifest id of the source.

evidence.description: Where the number or statement comes from.
